correction_reason: Native PRAISE ParAll terminal-branch completion sends a zero-byte __PRAISE_COMPLETE__ message from each provider back to the composition controller colocated with Fpre. The prior G0 adapter omitted the resulting one-hop propagation delay from the critical branch latency. This is a simulator-semantics defect correction, not retuning from white-box outcomes.
scientific_role: Minimal topology-aware analytic baseline from already-fixed I1 provider cards. M0 composes local LCQ boundaries forward through G, reads every provider card at rho_i=rho_G, and multiplies the corresponding local sigma values under its independence model. It is a predictor/baseline, not a guaranteed certificate for the global rho_G query.

allowed: exogenous global admissibility query A_G and rho_G
deterministic fixed-stage, native composition-control, and network boundary terms
forbidden: redistributing or optimizing rho_G across providers

global_query_relation: Compose the already-fixed local A_i boundaries forward through G. M0 is applicable to an exogenous A_G only when the induced boundary is contained in A_G: l_M0<=l_G, c_M0<=c_G, q_M0>=q_G.

native_parallel_control.identified_by: native graph smoke exact-latency audit plus AICon/YAFS runtime source semantics

phase1_benchmark_adapter.network_path_accounting: root hop + Fpre service + one outbound branch hop + one zero-byte provider-to-controller completion-control hop on the critical parallel branch + join hop + Fpost service

probability_composition.interpretation: analytic prediction/baseline for the global admissibility probability, not a lower bound or certification guarantee

known_limitation.statement: Even if c_i>=rho_G for every provider, this does not in general imply c_G>=rho_G for an all-required composition. M0 deliberately does not allocate a tighter local violation budget.
known_limitation.scientific_role: Deliberate baseline limitation motivating richer integration methods such as M1.

evaluation_lock: The same-rho M0 probability rule remains unchanged. Only the omitted native completion-control latency in the public deterministic G0 adapter is corrected.
